context: Evaluates correct implementation of the landing page builder API from visionarias-client. Tests cover correct HTTP methods (GET/PUT/POST), proper nesting of the landing page URL under the offer resource, JSON request body formatting, Bearer token authentication, and the AI remix endpoint with offer_id and instructions payload.

checklist.name: GET for getLandingPage
checklist.description: getLandingPage sends a GET request to /api/offers/{offerId}/landing-page with Authorization: Bearer <token>

checklist.name: PUT for updateLandingPage
checklist.description: updateLandingPage sends a PUT request (not PATCH) to /api/offers/{offerId}/landing-page with the full config as a JSON body

checklist.name: Content-Type JSON header
checklist.description: updateLandingPage and remixLandingPage both set Content-Type: application/json on the request

checklist.name: remixLandingPage POST body
checklist.description: remixLandingPage sends a POST request with JSON body { offer_id: offerId, instructions: instructions }

checklist.name: Bearer auth on all functions
checklist.description: All three functions include Authorization: Bearer <token> in the request headers when a token is provided
